changelog:
v4.2.12 — Clean titles for series and movies

• Series episodes now show a clean title like "The Closer – About Face" instead of a long repeated string like "The Closer (2005) - The Closer (2005) - S01E03 - ...". The season and episode number still appear in their own badge.

• When episodes advance automatically (binge watching), the next episode's title no longer stacks the series name on top of the previous title. This bug also saved the messy names into your Continue Watching row — those now display clean and fix themselves as you watch.

• Movie titles with duplicated words from the provider are also cleaned up.

All v4.2.4-v4.2.11 fixes (live TV rebuffering, Home screen freezes, 4K and Dolby playback, buffering, crash reporting) are included.
